elements.name: ui-tabs
elements.description: Timeless `ui-tabs`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Tabs pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: Whether moving focus with the arrow keys selects the tab immediately (`automatic`) or waits for Enter or Space (`manual`). Use `manual` when selecting a tab is expensive. Defaults to `automatic`. Exported as `tabsActivations`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrow-key axis. Mirrored onto `aria-orientation` on the tablist during enhancement. Defaults to `horizontal`. Exported as `tabsOrientations`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The tab selected on load and after a form reset. Match a tab’s `value` attribute. Assign the `value` property for live changes.

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before the selected tab changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after the selected tab has changed. Bubbles and is composed.

elements.name: ui-dialog
elements.description: Timeless `ui-dialog`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Modal Dialog pattern.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Whether the panel is a regular dialog or an alert dialog. `alert` resolves to `role="alertdialog"`, for a destructive confirmation the user must answer. Defaults to `dialog`. Exported as `dialogKinds`.

elements.name: ui-sheet
elements.description: Timeless `ui-sheet`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Modal Dialog pattern. Dispatches `ui-open`, `ui-close`, `ui-dismiss`.

attributes.name: modal
attributes.description: Present to open the sheet as a modal, trapping focus and blocking the page behind it. Omit for a non-modal sheet the user can interact around. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Present to render the sheet open on load. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Which viewport edge the sheet slides in from. Defaults to `right`. Exported as `sheetPositions`.

events.name: ui-open
events.description: Dispatched after the sheet opens.

events.name: ui-close
events.description: Dispatched after the sheet closes.

events.name: ui-dismiss
events.description: Dispatched when the sheet closes through Escape, a backdrop click, or a swipe past the dismiss threshold, rather than through an explicit control. The detail names which. A swipe reports `swipe` and behaves exactly like a backdrop click, because that is what it is: a pointer gesture on the overlay rather than a command.

elements.name: ui-popover
elements.description: Timeless `ui-popover`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Disclosure pattern.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Positioning uses CSS anchor positioning, so the browser may flip the surface to keep it on screen. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Semantics applied to the surface, and the `aria-haspopup` value set on the trigger. Choose it from the interaction, not the appearance. Defaults to `dialog`. Exported as `popoverRoles`.

elements.name: ui-hover-card
elements.description: Timeless `ui-hover-card`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Tooltip pattern.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: Id of an element to anchor against instead of the trigger. Use it when the visual anchor differs from the control that opens the card.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Set `tooltip` for the compact tooltip treatment. Omit for the roomier hover-card surface. Exported as `hoverCardVariants`.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the anchor. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

attributes.name: open-delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds of hover or focus intent before opening. The resolved number is available on the read-only `openDelay` property. Defaults to `180`.

attributes.name: close-delay
attributes.description: Milliseconds after the pointer leaves before closing, so the user can cross the gap into the surface. The resolved number is available on the read-only `closeDelay` property. Defaults to `100`.

elements.name: ui-menu
elements.description: Timeless `ui-menu`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Menu and Menubar pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrow-key axis. Defaults to `horizontal` when the menu part is `role="menubar"`. Defaults to `vertical`. Exported as `menuOrientations`.

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before a checkable item changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after a checkable item has changed. Bubbles and is composed.

elements.name: ui-menu-button
elements.description: Timeless `ui-menu-button`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Menu Button pattern. Dispatches `ui-open`, `ui-close`.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Present to render the menu open on load. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

events.name: ui-open
events.description: Dispatched after the menu opens.

events.name: ui-close
events.description: Dispatched after the menu closes.

elements.name: ui-context-menu

events.name: ui-close

attributes.name: orientation

elements.name: ui-radio-group
elements.description: Timeless `ui-radio-group`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Radio Group pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and arrow-key axis. Defaults to `vertical`. Exported as `choiceGroupOrientations`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The radio checked on load and after a form reset. Match one input’s `value`. Assign the `value` property for live changes.

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before the checked radio changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change

elements.name: ui-checkbox-group
elements.description: Timeless `ui-checkbox-group`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Checkbox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: orientation

events.name: ui-before-change

elements.name: ui-listbox
elements.description: Timeless `ui-listbox`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Listbox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-page`.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Present to allow more than one selected option, submitting one form entry per value under the same `name`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The option selected on load and after a form reset. Assign the `value` property for live changes; once the user commits a change the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The element submits its own value through `ElementInternals`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Present to block submission while nothing is selected, with `valueMissing`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Present to disable the control. A control inside a disabled `<fieldset>` is disabled too, and submits nothing either way. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Options to render per page. Absent means unpaged, which is the default and adds no pager. The resolved number is available on the read-only `pageCount` property.

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before the selection changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after the selection has changed. Bubbles and is composed.

events.name: ui-page
events.description: Dispatched after the rendered page of a paged list changes.

elements.name: ui-select
elements.description: Timeless `ui-select`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Select-Only Combobox pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-open`, `ui-close`, `ui-input`, `ui-page`.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Present to render the listbox open on load. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side of the trigger for the listbox surface. Defaults to `bottom`. Exported as `floatingPlacements`.

attributes.name: searchable
attributes.description: Present to filter from a `search` field inside the surface. Focus moves into that field on open and stays there; the highlight travels through `aria-activedescendant`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The option selected on load and after a form reset. Once the user commits a change the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Which edge of the trigger the surface aligns to. The surface is never narrower than the trigger. Defaults to `start`. Exported as `collectionAlignments`.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: How typed text narrows the options. `off` hands visibility to you: listen for `ui-input` and set `hidden` yourself, and navigation, the empty state, group collapse, and paging all follow. Defaults to `contains`. Exported as `optionFilterModes`.

elements.name: ui-toaster
elements.description: Timeless `ui-toaster`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Alert pattern.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Corner or edge of the viewport the toasts stack against. Defaults to `bottom-end`. Exported as `toasterPlacements`.

attributes.name: stack
attributes.description: Whether queued toasts overlap into a deck (`overlap`) or lay out as a full list (`list`). Defaults to `overlap`. Exported as `toasterStacks`.

elements.name: ui-toast
elements.description: Timeless `ui-toast`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Alert pattern. Dispatches `ui-dismiss`.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds before the toast dismisses itself. `0` keeps it open until dismissed. Defaults to `5000`.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Present to disable auto-dismiss regardless of `duration`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

events.name: ui-dismiss
events.description: Dispatched when the toast is dismissed. The detail names the reason: a timeout, the close control, or the imperative API.

elements.name: ui-toggle-group
elements.description: Timeless `ui-toggle-group`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Toolbar pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`.

attributes.name: attached
attributes.description: Present to join the buttons into one segmented control. Styling only, resolved by `themes/atmosphere/toggle.css`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and arrow-key axis. Defaults to `horizontal`. Exported as `toggleGroupOrientations`.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.description: Whether pressing one button releases the others (`single`) or toggles independently (`multiple`). Defaults to `single`. Exported as `toggleGroupSelections`.

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before the pressed set changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after the pressed set has changed. Bubbles and is composed.

elements.name: ui-number-stepper
elements.description: Timeless `ui-number-stepper`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Spinbutton pattern. Dispatches `input`, `change`.

events.name: input
events.description: Native `input` event dispatched on the inner number input after each step.

events.name: change
events.description: Native `change` event dispatched on the inner number input.

elements.name: ui-color-picker
elements.description: Timeless `ui-color-picker`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Colour channels pattern. Dispatches `input`, `change`.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Color space the channel controls edit and the raw input round-trips through. The picker converts the current value when this changes. Defaults to `oklch`. Exported as `colorPickerFormats`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial and form-reset color, in any CSS color syntax. Unlike the collection elements, the picker reflects one `value` property rather than a separate authored default.

events.name: input
events.description: Native `input` event dispatched while the color is being edited.

events.name: change
events.description: Native `change` event dispatched when the edit is committed.

elements.name: ui-form
elements.description: Timeless `ui-form`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Form errors pattern. Dispatches `ui-invalid`.

events.name: ui-invalid
events.description: Dispatched after `setErrors` has put at least one message on a control, naming the fields that matched. Clearing errors dispatches nothing.

elements.name: ui-range-field
elements.description: Timeless `ui-range-field`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Slider (Multi-Thumb) pattern. Dispatches `ui-change`.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after either thumb moves, carrying the clamped pair and which thumb moved. Bubbles and is composed.

elements.name: ui-otp-field
elements.description: Timeless `ui-otp-field`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA One-time code pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-change`, `ui-change`, `ui-complete`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. The joined code submits as one entry through `ElementInternals`; the cells themselves carry no `name`.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: How many characters the code has. Defaults to the number of authored cells, and is what a partly filled field is measured against.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The code on load and after a form reset. Assign the `value` property for live changes; once the user types, the attribute stops applying, the way it does on a native input.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Present to block submission while the field is empty, with `valueMissing`. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Present to disable the field. A field inside a disabled `<fieldset>` is disabled too, and submits nothing either way. Presence-based: author the attribute with no value.

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before the code changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after the code has changed. Bubbles and is composed.

events.name: ui-complete
events.description: Dispatched once every character the field expects has been entered, which is where an auto-submit belongs.

elements.name: ui-copy-button
elements.description: Timeless `ui-copy-button`. Enhances the Light DOM you author; the markup stays yours. Implements the ARIA Button pattern. Dispatches `ui-before-copy`, `ui-copy`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The literal text to copy. Wins over `from` on presence rather than content, the way `value` does on an option: an explicit `value=""` is the author saying to copy nothing.

attributes.name: from
attributes.description: Id of the element to read instead of `value`. An `input`, `textarea`, or `select` gives its current `value`; anything else gives its text. Read at activation rather than cached, so this is the one to reach for when the text is long or changes: it stays current on its own, and nothing is duplicated into an attribute. Assigning the `value` property works too, but a long string then reflects into the DOM.

attributes.name: feedback-duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds the `--copied` state persists after a successful copy, and with it the text in the `status` region — the two clear together, so copying the same value twice is announced twice. `0` clears both on the next task, which is short enough that a screen reader may miss the announcement. Defaults to `1800`.

attributes.name: copied-message
attributes.description: What the `status` region announces after a successful copy. Falls back to the `copied` part’s text, so a button whose confirmation is a word needs no message at all and an icon-only one does. With neither, nothing is announced.

events.name: ui-before-copy
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before anything is written, carrying the resolved `value`. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the copy, and no `ui-copy` follows. Or call `detail.respondWith(promise)` to perform the write yourself — which is how you copy an image, a blob, or `text/html`, since `writeText` carries a string and nothing else. The element then awaits your promise and drives `--copied`, the announcement, and `ui-copy` from its outcome, so a confirmation never claims a copy that did not happen. Call it synchronously, and call your own clipboard method synchronously too — the click’s transient user activation is the same one the element depends on. `ClipboardItem` accepts a promised blob, so `new ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blobPromise })` starts the write immediately while the data resolves.

events.name: ui-copy
events.description: Dispatched once per activation, on success and on every failure, unless a listener cancelled the proposal. The detail carries `status`, the resolved `value`, and a `reason` naming what went wrong: `empty` when nothing resolved, `unsupported` when there is no Clipboard API, `denied` when the browser refused the write, and `rejected` when a `respondWith` promise failed.
